posts.author: Bird of Prey
posts.content_md:
On page 30, paragraph 2 of Shoebox Holography, it states that holograms have even been made on billboards. Is there an address on the internet where I can see one of these? I would be curious to know exactly HOW BIG of a billboard they are talking about.

I didn't count on the book - which reads more like an instruction manual - arriving until after Christmas. Or maybe sometime next month. Total arrival time from Edmund Scientifics was about 2 weeks. Don't know if they will ship this quickly for everyone, but my experience with them was entirely to my satisfaction.

I found a couple references to billboard holograms.

[http://geekdom.net/photoblog/archives/000231.html](http://geekdom.net/photoblog/archives/000231.html)

posts.author: Dinesh
posts.content_md:
It was a dot matrix hologram by Rob Mundy. I can't find a link to it, but I believe he covered the entire side of a building holographiclly.

Talking of holograms in airports, I remember the "Tiffen" hologram - a rainbow, fairly large, advertising Tiffen colour filters. ( [http://www.holonet.khm.de/jross/collection/burns.html](http://www.holonet.khm.de/jross/collection/burns.html) ). I think this was the first large display piece I'd ever seen in Heathrow Airport sometime in the early 80's.
